title: SAP pricing: the condition lines of sales, billing and purchasing documents (KONV in ECC, PRCD_ELEMENTS in S/4HANA) and the condition records behind them
status_note: Every table, key and relationship below is taken from public documentation and written in our own words. None of it has been checked against an SAP system by this project; validate_plan checks it against your rows. A pack is a sourced suggestion, not proof.

variants.ecc: SAP ERP 6.0 (ECC): document conditions in KONV. Not verified per enhancement package.
variants.s4hana: SAP S/4HANA: document conditions in PRCD_ELEMENTS. Whether KONV still exists (empty, or as a view) depends on release and is not asserted.

tables.name: KONV
tables.en: Document conditions (pricing lines of a document)
tables.note: One row per condition (price, discount, surcharge, tax, subtotal) per item of a document; KPOSN 000000 holds conditions of the whole document. The document finds its conditions through its own KNUMV column, not through its document number.

tables.name: PRCD_ELEMENTS
tables.en: Document conditions (pricing lines of a document), S/4HANA
tables.note: Takes KONV's place in S/4HANA with the same key.

tables.name: KONH
tables.note: Validity (DATAB, DATBI) and the condition type of a price or discount record.

tables.name: KONP
tables.note: KBETR is a rate, not an amount: a price per KPEIN units of KMEIN, or a percentage, as KONWA and KRECH say.

tables.name: T685
tables.note: The key carries usage (KVEWE) and application (KAPPL): pricing in sales is usage A, application V; purchasing is application M. Document conditions carry only KSCHL, so the link is listed, not applied.

traps.title: Documents find their conditions through KNUMV
traps.text: VBAK, VBRK and EKKO carry a condition number KNUMV; their conditions are the KONV (ECC) or PRCD_ELEMENTS (S/4HANA) rows with that KNUMV, and an item's are those with KPOSN equal to the item number. Joining on the document number VBELN or EBELN finds nothing.

traps.title: Summing all condition values is not the net value
traps.text: A document's conditions include prices, discounts, surcharges, taxes, subtotals and statistical conditions. Adding every KWERT counts subtotals and statistical lines on top of the lines they summarise. Pick condition types (KSCHL), leave out inactive (KINAK) and statistical (KSTAT) lines, and remember that header conditions (KPOSN 000000) are also distributed to the items.

traps.title: KBETR is a rate, KWERT a value
traps.text: KBETR is a price per pricing unit or a percentage (the calculation type KRECH says which), stored in its own scale; KWERT is the resulting amount in the document currency. Summing KBETR adds rates of different kinds.

traps.title: KONV in ECC, PRCD_ELEMENTS in S/4HANA
traps.text: S/4HANA keeps document conditions in PRCD_ELEMENTS with the same key. A pipeline that extracts KONV from an S/4HANA system may get no rows; extract the table the variant has.

traps.title: Condition records are valid for a period
traps.text: A condition record (KONH) has a validity period; the record a document used is the one in its KNUMH, not the one valid today.
